symptoms.symptom: Small amount of water remaining in dispenser (on some models) at end of cycle

causes.label: Normal dispenser operation
remedies: It is normal for a small amount of water to remain in dispenser after the cycle.

symptoms.symptom: Short spray or turn on of drain pump and delay after pushing the Start button

causes.label: Lid was opened and closed between cycle selection and start
remedies: This is normal.
See START-UP SEQUENCE in the Safety Instructions section.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 26: "Lid was opened and closed between cycle selection and start"

causes.label: This is normal
remedies: Water may not cover the top level of the clothes.
This is normal for this high efficiency washer.

causes.label: Soft water
remedies: Try less detergent.

causes.label: Too much detergent
remedies: Measure your detergent carefully.
Use less soap if you have soft water, a smaller load or a lightly soiled load.

causes.label: Type of detergent
remedies: Switch to High Efficiency detergent such as Tide PODS™ and liquid detergents.

causes.label: Type of detergent
remedies: Switch to High Efficiency detergent such as Tide PODS™ and liquid detergents.

causes.label: Using too much detergent in washer
remedies: Use less detergent.
Use less soap if you have soft water, a smaller load or a lightly soiled load.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 26: "Using too much detergent in washer"

causes.label: Fill hoses or drain hose
remedies: Make sure hose connections are tight at faucets and rubber
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 26: "Fill hoses or drain hose"

symptoms.symptom: Washer spins and pauses at the beginning of cycles

causes.label: This is normal
remedies: The washer is sensing the load.

symptoms.symptom: Speed changes before during and after spin

causes.label: Washer adjusts speeds over several minutes
remedies: This is normal.
The washer will automatically adjust speeds before, during and after the spin cycle to most effectively distribute and spin the wash load.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 27: "Washer adjusts speeds over several minutes"

causes.label: The Soak Option was chosen
remedies: This is normal.
The washer alternates between agitate and soak during these cycles to get your clothes cleaner with less wear.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 27: "The Soak Option was chosen"

causes.label: This is normal
remedies: Many cycles incorporate as series of soaks within the agitation period to get your clothes clean with less wear.

causes.label: This is normal
remedies: The washer may pause during the spin cycle to remove soapy water more efficiently.

causes.label: Washer is unplugged
remedies: Make sure cord is plugged securely into a working outlet.

causes.label: Water supply is turned off
remedies: Turn both hot and cold faucets fully on.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 27: "Water supply is turned off"

causes.label: Lid is open—safety feature prevents agitation and spinning when lid is up
remedies: Close lid and press Start.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 27: "Lid is open—safety feature prevents agitation and spinning when lid is up"

causes.label: Circuit breaker/fuse is tripped/blown
remedies: Check house circuit breakers/fuses.
Replace fuses or reset breaker.
Washer should have a separate outlet.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 27: "Circuit breaker/fuse is tripped/blown"

causes.label: Electronics need to be reset
remedies: Unplug washer, wait 2 minutes, plug back in and press Start.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 27: "Electronics need to be reset"

causes.label: Start was not pressed
remedies: Press Start.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 27: "Start was not pressed"

symptoms.symptom: Detergent packet not dissolving in Laundry Pack Dispenser chamber

causes.label: Wash water too cold or detergent packet type/ quantity
remedies: We recommend the use of High Efficiency              laundry packs such as Tide PODS™ or Gain Flings™.
When using delicates cycle, place detergent pack in the bottom of the basket as this will help break down the pack with the gentler agitation.
Select a warmer wash temperature. if possible, to improve dissolving of detergent packets.
Use the secondary chamber by removing the Laundry Pack Cup (on GTW720 and GTW725 models only).
Do not exceed manufacturer’s recommended dosing quantity.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 27: "Wash water too cold or detergent packet type/ quantity"

symptoms.symptom: Unexplained time and/ or settings changes

causes.label: Changing options (on some models)
remedies: This is normal.
Several options will change other options to maximize washer performance.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 27: "Changing options (on some models)"

causes.label: Incorrect use of fabric softener
remedies: Check fabric softener package for instructions and follow directions for using dispenser.
Make sure you have selected the Deep Rinse option.
Pretreat stain and rewash using Speed Wash cycle before drying.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 27: "Incorrect use of fabric softener"

causes.label: Dye transfer
remedies: Sort whites or lightly colored items from dark colors.

causes.label: Detergent amount
remedies: Be sure to follow detergent manufacturer’s directions.

causes.label: Hard water
remedies: Use a water conditioner or install a water softener.

causes.label: Clothes are air or line dried
remedies: If you do not dry your clothes with a clothes dryer, your clothes may retain more lint.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 27: "Clothes are air or line dried"

causes.label: Incorrect sorting
remedies: Separate lint producers from lint collectors.

causes.label: Washing too long
remedies: Wash small loads for a shorter time using Light Soil setting.

causes.label: No spin selected
remedies: Select a spin option.

causes.label: Incorrect cycle selected
remedies: Make sure the cycle selected matches the load you are washing.
Some fabrics will feel wetter when rinsed with cold water.

symptoms.symptom: Snags, holes, tears, rips or excessive wear

causes.label: Pins, snaps, hooks, sharp buttons, belt buckles, zippers and sharp objects left in pockets
remedies: Fasten snaps, hooks, buttons and zippers.
Remove loose items like pins, objects in pockets and sharp buttons.
Turn knits (which snag easily) inside out.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 28: "Pins, snaps, hooks, sharp buttons, belt buckles, zippers and sharp objects left in pockets"

causes.label: Incorrect wash and dry cycles
remedies: Match Cycle selection to the type of fabric you are washing (especially for easy care loads).
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 28: "Incorrect wash and dry cycles"

causes.label: Improper sorting
remedies: Avoid mixing heavy items (like jeans) with light items (like blouses).
Try a fabric softener.

causes.label: Overloading
remedies: Loosely load clothes in the washer basket.

causes.label: Repeated washing in water that is too hot
remedies: Wash in warm or cold water.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 28: "Repeated washing in water that is too hot"

causes.label: Possible Causes
remedies: Reason

causes.label: Motor ramping up/down during spin cycle
remedies: The motor will speed up incrementally during the spin cycle.
When spin is complete, it will coast until it stops.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 28: "Motor ramping up/down during spin cycle"

causes.label: Water drain pump
remedies: The drain pump will make a humming sound when pumping out water after agitation stops and continue until spin is complete.

causes.label: Drive motor
remedies: The drive motor will make a “humming” sound during the wash and spin phases of the cycle.

causes.label: Water drain pump
remedies: When the pump starts drawing in air, It starts to gurgle.
The washer should then begin spinning and the sound will continue until it is done spinning.

causes.label: Washing process
remedies: Water swishing while the unit is agitating is normal, especially with smaller loads.

causes.label: Washer leveling legs uneven
remedies: To level the washer, adjust the leveling legs by rotating the individual leg in the proper direction for up or down.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 28: "Washer leveling legs uneven"

causes.label: Washer not level and rubbing on cabinet
remedies: To level the washer, adjust the leveling legs by rotating the individual leg in the proper direction for up or down.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 28: "Washer not level and rubbing on cabinet"
